purpose.text: Verification-pass pipeline that turns a `GraphSpec` into a checked `GraphIr`. Resolution binds descriptors; ordered passes validate ids, ports, media, clock domains, realtime boundaries, and acyclicity. Lowering into a `RuntimePlan` lives in `planner::RuntimePlanner` (Wave 5).
